scope: Finite reviewed catalogue. Only unpublished original scenes and unused unordered musical programmes may be produced. No fallback to cosmetic variants.

scene.description: A warm window seat shelters Jagoncito, a sleepy kitten and a tiny mouse from the rainy forest outside.
scene.animation: Gentle rain, warm firelight and very subtle kitten breathing accompany the piano.

axes.scenario: woodland window-seat music room at night
axes.microstory: companions settle with a warm cup while rain crosses the forest
axes.focal_object: warm cup, knitted blanket and sleeping companions
axes.viewer_projection: winding down in a sheltered room
axes.palette: deep midnight blue, candle gold and rust velvet

plans.title: Quiet Reading in Jagoncito’s Pottery Workshop | Satie Piano

scene.description: Clay bowls and an open sketchbook rest on a sheltered workbench above a rain-soaked forest. Jagoncito has found a quiet corner while a kitten sleeps beneath the stool.
scene.animation: Delicate rain moves outdoors beyond the pottery workshop.

axes.microstory: an open sketchbook rests among freshly worked bowls
axes.viewer_projection: a quiet reading pause at the craft bench
axes.palette: moss green, terracotta and pale rainlit forest

plans.title: A Quiet Harbor Break with Jagoncito | Satie Piano & Rain

scene.description: A model sailboat, a compass and an open notebook wait on a sheltered boathouse workbench as rain passes across the harbour. Jagoncito and his small companions keep the quiet repair work company.
scene.animation: Fine rain moves across the distant harbour opening.

axes.microstory: a model sailboat rests on the repair table as rain crosses the harbour
axes.focal_object: wooden model sailboat and navigation charts
axes.viewer_projection: an unhurried harbour break beside a restoration project
axes.palette: weathered teak, warm brass and cool misty harbour blue
